name: Emeria
description: Emeria is a vast hedron field and ruined Skyclave floating above Tazeem on Zendikar, and also the name of a merfolk sky goddess that proved to be a distorted memory of Emrakul.

description_citations.text: "Gods and Monsters". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Mar 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

summary.text: Emeria is a vast hedron field and ruined Skyclave floating above Tazeem on Zendikar, and also the name of a merfolk sky goddess that proved to be a distorted memory of Emrakul.

citations.text: "Gods and Monsters". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Mar 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

bio.text: The archangel Iona destroyed the Tazeem Skyclave, ending the Makindi reign and creating Emeria.

citations.text: "Tazeem", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: The angelic goddess Emeria was conceptualized from the silhouette of Emrakul, and her worshippers abandoned their temples when they learned she was a twisted memory of Emrakul.

citations.text: "The Defiance of Angels". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.
Cloud Manta (Battle for Zendikar, 2015), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

bio.text: Gideon's army descended from the hedrons of Emeria for its first march on Sea Gate.

citations.text: "The Liberation of Sea Gate" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Oct 2015.

bio.text: Jace later met an angel he recognized as Emeria, but he concluded she was his mind's personification of Emrakul and checkmated her at chess.

citations.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.
"The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

bio.text: Kesenya's adventurers climbed through Emeria and inadvertently triggered its defenses, awakening six more Skyclaves.

citations.text: "Rise of the Skyclaves", section "The reawakening". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Tazeem", section "Zendikar Rising". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: During the invasion the compleated Nahiri reactivated the Emeria Skyclave, fused herself into it as its keystone and realigned the hedrons for Realmbreaker.

citations.text: "Nahiri", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

citations.text: "March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2023.

bio.text: Akiri's party and Tazri broke Nahiri loose, and the Skyclave crashed with her inside.

citations.work: March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind
citations.text: "March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2023.
"Akiri", section "March of the Machine". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Afterward Nahiri woke in the wreck without her spark, which was lost when the hedron holding it cracked.

status.text: The Emeria Skyclave has crashed and lies in ruins, and Nahiri woke inside it without her spark.

citations.work: March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind
citations.text: "March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: The archangel Iona destroys the Tazeem Skyclave, ending the Makindi reign and creating Emeria.
timeline.quote: The Makindi reign ended when the archangel Iona destroyed the Tazeem Skyclave

citation.text: "Tazeem", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Zendikar's people mistake the halos for impartiality, and the angelic Emeria is conceptualized from the silhouette of Emrakul.
timeline.quote: And the terrible silhouette of Emrakul against the sky became Emeria, a vision of salvation on white-feathered wings.

citation.text: "The Defiance of Angels". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Flashback: As children, Kiora and Turi listen to Elder Misha's Cosi story about Cosi swapping Ula's spear for a feather.
timeline.quote: Cosi snuck to Ula's bedside at the bottom of the sea and swapped his great spear for a gull's feather

citation.text: "Home Waters" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Sep 2015.

timeline.summary: Emeria's worshippers learn she was a twisted memory of Emrakul and abandon temples.
timeline.quote: When Emeria's worshippers learned that she was no more than a twisted memory of Emrakul, they abandoned their temples to the god.

citation.text: Cloud Manta (Battle for Zendikar, 2015), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch and Liliana confront Emrakul at Thraben; Jace speaks with her figment Emeria.
timeline.quote: Emrakul was confronted by the Gatewatch and Liliana Vess

citation.text: "Emrakul", section "The Eldrazi released". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The army descends from the hedrons of Emeria, and Gideon leads its first march on Sea Gate with a shout of "For Zendikar!"
timeline.quote: He shouted, "For Zendikar!" and a deafening roar came in answer.

citation.text: "The Liberation of Sea Gate" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Oct 2015.

timeline.summary: Through a door at the stairway's end Jace meets an angel he recognizes as Emeria from Zendikar statues and wonders whether she is Emrakul.
timeline.quote: I know this angel.

citation.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Emeria offers Jace a game of chess: if he wins, all stops and she will give him answers.
timeline.quote: If you win, this all stops. I will give you all the answers you want.

citation.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace realizes the angel is his mind's personification of Emrakul and checkmates her.
timeline.quote: He put his hand on his queen, moved it into position.

citation.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace's chess pieces mutate and kill each other, and the angel says they were always her pieces and she no longer wants to play.
timeline.quote: They are all my pieces, Jace Beleren.

citation.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: The merfolk's gods Ula, Emeria and Cosi turn out to be false memories of the Eldrazi titans.
timeline.quote: The gods known to the merfolk as Ula, Emeria, and Cosi were nothing more than false memories of a monstrous trinity: the Eldrazi titans Ulamog, Emrakul, and Kozilek.

citation.text: Shrine of the Forsaken Gods (Commander 2019, 2019), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Kesenya's adventurers inadvertently trigger Emeria's defenses, awakening six more Skyclaves.
timeline.quote: the adventurers inadvertently triggered the Skyclave's dormant magical defenses

citation.text: "Rise of the Skyclaves", section "The reawakening". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The adventurers retrieve relics and found the Sea Gate Expeditionary House, inspiring new expeditions.
timeline.quote: became the founding members of the newly founded Sea Gate Expeditionary House

citation.text: "Rise of the Skyclaves", section "Aftermath and impact". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Adventurers ascend through Emeria, discover the Skyclave remnants and awaken the other six Skyclaves.
timeline.quote: they triggered the magical defenses of the ancient Skyclave

citation.text: "Tazeem", section "Zendikar Rising". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nahiri, compleated and with blades for hands, surveys the Phyrexian invasion from a floating stone and decides to use the Emeria Skyclave to connect the hedron networks.
timeline.quote: the Skyclave in Emeria will be the perfect access point to connect the entire hedron networks

citation.work: March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Akiri's party searches for Nahiri following Tazri's vision, and Akiri spots the changed Nahiri on an isolated fragment.
timeline.quote: She has changed, but even from a distance, Akiri knows who it is.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Akiri tracks Nahiri, watching the Skyclave turn to white metal and more invaders arrive.
timeline.quote: She's witnessed the Skyclave's broken stone mend and transform into white metal.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Linvala brings Tazri to Akiri's party, and they agree they are the only ones left to stop Nahiri.
timeline.quote: "We are the only ones left to stop Nahiri,"

citation.work: March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: The party enters the Skyclave through a small uncorrupted entrance, resolved to stop Nahiri.
timeline.quote: "We did not defeat the Eldrazi to be destroyed by this,"

citation.work: March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: The party kills a corrupted tree elemental, and Orah's fingers are covered in black oil.
timeline.quote: The tips of his fingers are covered in a sickly black oil.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Surrounded by Phyrexianized elementals, the party is saved when Linvala's light parts the elementals and reveals a door.
timeline.quote: Tazri looks and sees Linvala radiating with light and charging forward.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: They barricade the door and find the carcasses of the Skyclave's creatures.
timeline.quote: Around them are the carcasses of every living creature that didn't survive the Phyrexian transformation.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: In flashback, Nahiri recounts converting or killing the elementals and pouring her joy, anger and grief into the hedron network until nothing is left.
timeline.quote: So, she channeled her pain, her grief from the betrayals, the losses, the loneliness over the millennia.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Nahiri fuses herself into the Skyclave's heart as its keystone, pouring in her essence.
timeline.quote: becoming its keystone, the heart that binds her work here together.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: The party confronts Nahiri, who recognizes Akiri and smashes her thrown knife with stone.
timeline.quote: "Tiny elementals. Cute," Nahiri says

citation.work: March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Nahiri's stone attacks beat back Tazri and her friends, and it seems Zendikar is lost.
timeline.quote: Zendikar is lost.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Linvala's radiance and Tazri's halo burn away oil and stun Phyrexia's power; Tazri hurls the halo at Nahiri.
timeline.quote: Tazri yanks the halo off from around her neck and in one desperate movement, hurls it at the entombed Planeswalker.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: The keystone breaks and Nahiri crumbles out of the stone; the Skyclave begins to collapse.
timeline.quote: the keystone breaks and Nahiri crumbles from her stone and metal embrace.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Akiri leads her friends out of the collapsing Skyclave, leaping into the sky and catching a hedron with her rope.
timeline.quote: But Akiri is a master line-slinger and midway through their failing arc, she lets her rope fly.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: The Skyclave falls with the corrupted Planeswalker trapped inside, while the sky takes on a soft iridescent glow.
timeline.quote: The Emeria Skyclave is falling to the earth.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Zendikar: Battles in the Field and in the Mind" by A. T. Greenblatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Elesh Norn sends compleated Nahiri to conquer Zendikar; she reactivates the Emeria Skyclave and realigns the hedrons to call Realmbreaker, fusing with the stones.
timeline.quote: she fused herself with the stones in the center, becoming its keystone

citation.text: "Nahiri", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Compleated Nahiri arrives at the Emeria Skyclave and realigns hedrons to facilitate Realmbreaker's incursion; the Roil rises against her and is defeated.
timeline.quote: began realigning the plane's hedrons to facilitate Realmbreaker's incursion into the plane

citation.text: "Tazeem", section "March of the Machine". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nahiri, now without her spark and awake after the invasion, tears Phyrexian metal from her own body and then from the Skyclave, piling it in a cairn.
timeline.storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
timeline.quote: Nahiri ripped the taint of Phyrexia from her plane.

citation.work: March of the Machine: The Aftermath | Beyond Repair
citation.text: "March of the Machine: The Aftermath | Beyond Repair" by Emily Teng. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 May 2023.

timeline.summary: Nahiri recalls a blast of Halo and realizes she is alive but hollow, no longer a Planeswalker.
timeline.storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
timeline.quote: The core of her power, her spark, no longer a part of her.

citation.work: March of the Machine: The Aftermath | Beyond Repair
citation.text: "March of the Machine: The Aftermath | Beyond Repair" by Emily Teng. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 May 2023.

timeline.summary: A metal claw nearly stabs her and Phyrexian memories surge before she rejects them.
timeline.storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
timeline.quote: That was the ghost of Phyrexia. It was not her.

citation.work: March of the Machine: The Aftermath | Beyond Repair
citation.text: "March of the Machine: The Aftermath | Beyond Repair" by Emily Teng. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 May 2023.

timeline.summary: Nahiri reaches the chamber where she fused herself into the Skyclave and finds a hidden hedron containing her spark inside the wall.
timeline.storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
timeline.quote: It was her Planeswalker spark.

citation.work: March of the Machine: The Aftermath | Beyond Repair
citation.text: "March of the Machine: The Aftermath | Beyond Repair" by Emily Teng. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 May 2023.

timeline.summary: Filled with hope, Nahiri tears a stairway through the Skyclave's roof and climbs out into sunlight.
timeline.storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
timeline.quote: Sunlight dripped into the darkness.

citation.work: March of the Machine: The Aftermath | Beyond Repair
citation.text: "March of the Machine: The Aftermath | Beyond Repair" by Emily Teng. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 May 2023.

timeline.summary: Ajani appears, restored and still a planeswalker, saying he came looking for her and reporting the deaths and survivors among the former evangels.
timeline.storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
timeline.quote: "Hello, Nahiri," Ajani said.

citation.work: March of the Machine: The Aftermath | Beyond Repair
citation.text: "March of the Machine: The Aftermath | Beyond Repair" by Emily Teng. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 May 2023.

timeline.summary: Ajani proposes that he and Nahiri work together to make amends for what they did, and she refuses.
timeline.storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
timeline.quote: "Someone needs to make amends for what we've done.

citation.work: March of the Machine: The Aftermath | Beyond Repair
citation.text: "March of the Machine: The Aftermath | Beyond Repair" by Emily Teng. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 May 2023.

timeline.summary: Nahiri suspects Ajani has come to kill her as one of the former evangels.
timeline.storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
timeline.quote: What if he was here to kill her?

citation.work: March of the Machine: The Aftermath | Beyond Repair
citation.text: "March of the Machine: The Aftermath | Beyond Repair" by Emily Teng. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 May 2023.

timeline.summary: Nahiri accuses Ajani of slaughtering Theros's gods and murdering Jaya Ballard; he snarls in grief.
timeline.storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
timeline.quote: You slaughtered the gods of Theros. You murdered Jaya Ballard.

citation.work: March of the Machine: The Aftermath | Beyond Repair
citation.text: "March of the Machine: The Aftermath | Beyond Repair" by Emily Teng. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 May 2023.

timeline.summary: Nahiri flings stone to make a wall and the Skyclave dome collapses under her, dropping her onto her cairn.
timeline.storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
timeline.quote: and then the dome of the Skyclave collapsed beneath her feet.

citation.work: March of the Machine: The Aftermath | Beyond Repair
citation.text: "March of the Machine: The Aftermath | Beyond Repair" by Emily Teng. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 May 2023.

timeline.summary: Nahiri finds the hedron cracked and her spark gone, her last hope of regaining her power destroyed.
timeline.storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
timeline.quote: Her last hope at regaining her power—at becoming a Planeswalker once more—was gone.

citation.work: March of the Machine: The Aftermath | Beyond Repair
citation.text: "March of the Machine: The Aftermath | Beyond Repair" by Emily Teng. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 May 2023.

timeline.summary: Akiri, Linvala, Kaza, Orah and Tazri fought the compleated Nahiri in Emeria's Skyclave, which crashed with her inside.
timeline.quote: the Skyclave breaking and crashing to the ground with Nahiri still inside

citation.text: "Akiri", section "March of the Machine". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Iona keeps explorers from climbing too high, knowing Emeria the goddess was a fiction yet believing faith sustained her followers.
timeline.quote: Iona knew the truth—that the goddess Emeria was a fiction—but believed that faith in Emeria sustained her followers through the perils of Zendikar.

citation.text: "Emeria", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Compleated Nahiri realigns the hedrons at the Emeria Skyclave to help Realmbreaker's incursion; the Roil is defeated.
timeline.quote: The now- compleated planeswalker Nahiri arrived at the Emeria Skyclave and began realigning the plane's hedrons

citation.text: "Hedron", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Iona descended from Emeria to battle the Eldrazi, leaving the Sky Ruin unguarded, and did not return after Ulamog and Kozilek were destroyed.
timeline.quote: When Iona descended from Emeria to battle the Eldrazi, she left the Sky Ruin unguarded.

citation.text: "Iona", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tazri sends Akiri, Linvala, Kaza and Orah to Emeria, where they see compleated Nahiri return.
timeline.quote: where they witnessed the return of the compleated Nahiri

citation.text: "Kaza", section "March of the Machine". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The party fights Nahiri and breaks her from the Hedron network; the Skyclave crashes with her inside.
timeline.quote: the Skyclave breaking and crashing to the ground with Nahiri still inside

citation.text: "Kaza", section "March of the Machine". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The party, including Linvala, fights compleated Nahiri at Emeria and breaks her from the Hedron network.
timeline.quote: the party managed to break Nahiri loose from the reformed Hedron network and knock her from her feet

citation.text: "Linvala", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tazri sends the party to Emeria, where they witness the return of the compleated Nahiri.
timeline.quote: they witnessed the return of the compleated Nahiri

citation.text: "Orah", section "March of the Machine". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The party breaks Nahiri loose from the Hedron network and Linvala burns the oil from Orah's hand; the Skyclave crashes with Nahiri inside.
timeline.quote: Skyclave breaking and crashing to the ground with Nahiri still inside

citation.text: "Orah", section "March of the Machine". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

citation.text: Rise of the Eldrazi: card flavor text (Rise of the Eldrazi, 2010), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

citation.text: "Drop for Drop" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 May 2015.

pages_say.description: A god worshipped on Zendikar, in truth a twisted memory of Emrakul.

citation.work: Battle for Zendikar: card flavor text
citation.text: Battle for Zendikar: card flavor text (Battle for Zendikar, 2015), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

pages_say.description: The floating hedrons high above Tazeem where Gideon's army encamped.

citation.text: "The Liberation of Sea Gate" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Oct 2015.

pages_say.description: A tall hooded angel with two swords and writhing ribbons whom Jace knows from statues on Zendikar; in his mind she plays chess with him and speaks for Emrakul, though he concludes it is only his mind personifying Emrakul.

citation.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

citation.work: Conspiracy: Take the Crown: card flavor text
